stories.composition: Four regions use most of the near-white canvas. Upper narrow live rail with request, production agent, response. Below it a larger teal trace stream is sampled, unfolded under rubric into paired actual/expected strips, grouped into candidate clusters, and compared in an open fold with full transcript ribbons. Rejected patterns branch downward to a terminated spur; surviving patterns enter an issue queue. Bottom right a pinned source stack supplies a small on-demand diagnosis wedge. This is a read-only evidence process, not a dashboard. Text attaches to each operation. Smooth blank surfaces, no document-like pseudo-lines.
